payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of the practical application of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity search methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: The MAP at gold-k metric is designed to evaluate the performance of entity search methods in scenarios where coverage of various entity types is crucial, especially in user-generated text.
Using MAP at gold-k helps practitioners assess the suitability of entity search methods by addressing the representation of non-named and vague entities in their predictions.
The proposed evaluation metric complements existing metrics by focusing on the multifaceted nature of entities in benchmarks, which is important for knowledge base population.
